tools.name: preflight_check
tools.description: Scan Solidity source and return a security verdict. This is a paid call ($0.01 USDC on Base mainnet) that flows through x402; in dev mode (DEV_MODE=1) no payment is required.

tools.name: preflight_sim
tools.description: Simulate a transaction against a contract and return revert reason, gas used, balance deltas, and severity-scored findings. mode='quick' costs $0.05 (eth_call); mode='deep' costs $0.25 (anvil local fork with gas, balance_delta_wei, and internal_calls). Paid in USDC on Base mainnet via x402; DEV_MODE

tools.name: preflight_token_risk
tools.description: Check a token contract before trading it. Returns a honeypot transfer verdict, transfer tax percentage, and owner privileges as a severity-scored ScanReport. Paid call ($0.05 USDC on Base mainnet) via x402; DEV_MODE=1 skips payment.

tools.name: preflight_bundle
tools.description: Run a combined token-risk, address-risk, and optional source scan for one address in a single paid call ($0.15 USDC on Base mainnet). Returns the bundle JSON.

tools.name: preflight_verify
tools.description: Verify a past Preflight attestation by source digest (free). Returns the verification result JSON.

tools.name: preflight_pricing
tools.description: Return the Preflight service info and price list (free).
